#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""CLI with TOML configuration support using cyclopts."""

from pathlib import Path
from cyclopts import App
from cyclopts.sources import TOMLSource

# Create app with TOML configuration source
app = App(
    config_sources=[
        TOMLSource(
            file_path=Path("pyproject.toml"),
            section=["tool", "mycli"]
        )
    ]
)

@app.default
def hello(name: str = "World", greeting: str = "Hello"):
    """Say hello to someone.
    
    Parameters
    ----------
    name : str
        The name to greet.
    greeting : str
        The greeting to use.
    """
    print(f"{greeting}, {name}!")

@app.command
def goodbye(name: str = "World"):
    """Say goodbye to someone.
    
    Parameters
    ----------
    name : str
        The name to say goodbye to.
    """
    print(f"Goodbye, {name}!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Create example pyproject.toml if it doesn't exist
    config_file = Path("pyproject.toml")
    if not config_file.exists():
        config_file.write_text("""\
[tool.mycli]
name = "Alice"
greeting = "Hello"
""")
    
    # Command-line arguments override config file values
    # Examples:
    # python script.py              # Uses config values: "Hello, Alice!"
    # python script.py --name Bob   # "Hello, Bob!" (overrides config)
    # python script.py --greeting Hi --name Charlie  # "Hi, Charlie!"
    # python script.py goodbye --name Dave  # "Goodbye, Dave!"
    app()
